title: Fractional rectangular-prism volume as layers and exact measure
mathematical_invariants: base area has square units and volume has cubic units
height = volume ÷ base area when base area is nonzero
decomposing an edge decomposes volume additively without changing the total

learning_sequence.student_action: Inspect a unit cube partitioned to match fractional edge units; use the text-equivalent layer table to identify cells across, deep, and high without calculating the final volume.
Compare two volumes for prisms with the same base—one at height 1 unit and one at the stated height—then predict how changing height or halving one edge changes filled space.
Partition edges, build one fractional-cell layer, change the number of layers, and compare the announced base-area and total-volume states after each keyboard action.
Connect cells per layer × number of layers to length × width × height; name why the result uses cubic units and verify an inverse dimension by recomposition.
Solve fresh packing, mixed-edge, inverse-height, and decomposition variants while recording operation, base area, layer reasoning, exact result, unit, equation, and check.

Route all seven structured fields—operation, base/layer size, layer reasoning, exact answer, exact unit family/power, equation, and reconstruction check—to one evidence-specific repair; complete a fresh contrast item before the corresponding scaffold fades. Free-form prose is not automatically scored.
In an unfamiliar mold context, decide whether volume or height is unknown before selecting direct multiplication or inverse division, then justify the exact unit.
Submit a hidden fresh seven-field variant with no partitions, cell count, hints, worked steps, or answer; backend trusted scoring remains unimplemented.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: Submitted exact value equals length × width while height was not incorporated.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: How many copies of this base layer fill the stated height?
misconception_pathways.repair: Build one layer, label its square-unit area, then stack the required fractional number of layers and record the changed unit power.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Solve a new prism with the same base and a different fractional height.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: The learner distinguishes base area from volume and includes height on two consecutive fresh items.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: Submitted value equals length + width + height.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: Does adding three distances count cells in a layer and layers in the solid?
misconception_pathways.repair: Construct an array for one layer, then treat height as the layer multiplier; compare the sum and product by unit type.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Choose between edge sum and edge product for a different prism and explain the dimensional unit.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: The learner selects multiplicative layer structure and rejects an additive distractor with a unit reason.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: Submitted value matches the product after fractional parts of mixed edges are discarded.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: Which portion of the prism disappears when the fractional edge part is ignored?
misconception_pathways.repair: Decompose the mixed edge, find both partial-prism volumes, and recombine them exactly.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Solve a fresh mixed-edge prism by direct product and decomposition and compare results.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: Both exact methods agree on a fresh item and no edge part is omitted.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: Exact numeric value is correct but the response uses the wrong base unit family, the wrong dimensional power, or cubic units for a recovered length.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: How many independent length directions were multiplied or remain after division?
misconception_pathways.repair: Label edge, layer, and stack measures as length, square units, and cubic units; cancel units in the inverse equation.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Attach and explain the unit power on one direct-volume and one missing-height item.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: The learner supplies the exact unit family, correct power, and cancellation explanation on both structures.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: The selected operation does not match whether volume or one dimension is unknown.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: Are you combining three known lengths, or undoing a known base area from a known volume?
misconception_pathways.repair: Mark the unknown in V = Bh, name the known base area, and choose multiplication for V or division for h before calculating.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Classify two new contexts—one direct and one inverse—without arithmetic first.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: Both operation classifications and explanations are correct before numbers are shown.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: For a missing height, submitted value equals volume × base area.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: If base area times height makes volume, which operation isolates height?
misconception_pathways.repair: Use a balance-style equation V = B × h, divide both sides by nonzero B, then recompose B × h to check V.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Recover a new fractional height and verify it by multiplication.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: The inverse operation and recomposition check both succeed on a fresh variant.

misconception_pathways.observed_signature: For a missing height, submitted value equals volume minus base area.
misconception_pathways.socratic_probe: Which multiplication relationship connects base area, height, and volume?
misconception_pathways.repair: Write V = B × h, compare subtraction with division using units, then divide both sides by nonzero B.
misconception_pathways.exit_check: Recover a new fractional height and show that base area times height reconstructs volume.
misconception_pathways.fade_when: The learner selects division and completes the exact multiplication check on a fresh variant.

keyboard_requirements: adjust edge partition denominator and numerator
move among base cells and layers without drag
reset without losing the current prompt
accessibility_and_mve.screen_reader_equivalence: Announce exact edge lengths, partition counts, current base-cell count, current layer count, and volume state in a nonvisual table; never require rotation to obtain evidence.
accessibility_and_mve.reduced_motion: Use discrete layer states with animation disabled under reduced-motion preference.
accessibility_and_mve.focus_recovery: Preserve all seven response fields and return focus to the first inconsistent field with its misconception code.

seeded_practice.oracle: Independent edge product or volume/base-area quotient reconstruction in tests

independent_assessment_contract.guided_structured_evaluator: diagnose_reasoning_evidence checks all seven fields in guided mode only and never awards mastery
independent_assessment_contract.unseen_transfer: TRANSFER_MOLD_PLAN requires operation selection before arithmetic and alternates direct volume with inverse height.
